title: Integer diagonal forms of general subset-intersection Laplacians
author: Ducey, Joshua E.; Engelthaler, Lauren; Gathje, Jacob; Jones, Brant; Pfaff, Isabel; Plute, Jenna
work: Integer diagonal forms for subset intersection relations

primary_locator.required_core: complete Bier block reduction, standard-subset stacked-matrix rank/index proofs, constructive simultaneous integral unimodular E_s matrices and small-block extraction with exact multiplicities

difficulty_reason: The core obligation is a simultaneous integral unimodular reduction of all subset-inclusion blocks, followed by extraction of independent small matrix summands with exact multiplicities. Sections 1–3, especially Theorems 2.8 and 2.10, supply this constructive integral reduction; it is not the rational spectral diagonalization available in routine linear algebra.

source_check.note: The selected problem is Theorem 3.4: the exact integral diagonal form and Smith-group direct-sum formula for the subset-intersection generalized Laplacian when n is at least 3k-1. The complete author body retains the graph/matrix/Smith-group definitions, Bier block reduction, stacked standard-subset rank and index proofs, constructive simultaneous unimodular reduction and the independent small-block extraction with exact multiplicities. All matrix schematics and diagrams are editable author TeX/TikZ. Named Smith-form and lattice-basis facts remain references; examples, rectangular extensions and later super-standard conjectures are unselected context. Frozen above-qualification and independent-unit approval retained; no new material or mathematical review.
